rationale: The Court is most likely to resolve narrowly on Seventh Amendment/Article III grounds, holding that SEC fraud-based civil-penalty actions are "suits at common law" requiring a jury and cannot be routed to in-house adjudication at the agency’s election. Separate writings are most likely from Justices Thomas and Gorsuch (and possibly Sotomayor in dissent) to address broader public-rights and Article II removal/insulation concerns.
